name: Flutter
experience: Flutter is where I started and where most of my production work still lives. From my first Starbucks UI clone to shipping Clyx Order and a dozen client apps, I've used it to build everything from simple booking tools to dual-role marketplace apps with real-time location tracking.
whyChosen: One codebase for iOS and Android matters a lot when you're delivering for small businesses on realistic budgets, and the widget model makes UI iteration fast without sacrificing native performance.
